Does .250 R TYP. also govern the four larger entrance-recess corners? The drawing shows rounded corners but the leader identifies the inner opening.
features.justification: The rectangular profile records only the known recess envelope, not an authorized square-corner substitute. Hold this entire feature until its corner radius is confirmed. Its floor is .500 below the OD crown; the outward cut overshoots the cylindrical surface. Preserve its independently dimensioned axial position rather than centering it on the inner opening.

features.rationale: Model the left coaxial internal thread cosmetically on its standard tap-drill bore.
features.justification: Use the standard 1-27/64 inch tap drill (1.421875) for a 1-1/2-12 thread. D012 is the specified threaded depth; this feature models that nominal depth without inventing an additional drilling allowance. Any continuation beyond the threaded length is held separately for review.

features.rationale: Confirm the left pilot-bore full-diameter extent: does it continue into the transverse opening beyond the 2.50 thread depth shown in section A-A?
features.justification: The callout specifies thread depth, not a separate pilot drilling depth. The section shows additional bore/thread-end lines near the opening but does not dimension their extent. The listed depth is only a held candidate terminating within the opening, not an approved drilling depth. Diameter 1.421875 is the standard 1-27/64 tap drill for 1-1/2-12.

features.rationale: Counterbore the right axial passage for a half-inch SHCS, with the clearance drill breaking into the transverse opening only.
features.justification: For D018=.500 SHCS, the supplied ASME B18.3 normal-fit chart gives clearance drill .531 and counterbore diameter .812. The explicitly printed D017 overrides the chart's default counterbore depth. Section A-A shows the passage ending in the transverse opening; drilling to its axial midpoint overshoots the right web without drilling the left web.

features.rationale: Seed tapped hole in the right end face at the negative-X, negative-Y location.
features.justification: Use the standard 5/16 inch (.3125) tap drill for D015=.375, 16-TPI UNC. Model the specified threaded depth as a flat-bottom nominal bore with cosmetic threads; no unprinted drill-point or extra bottom allowance is added. The end view shows symmetric offsets about both axis centerlines.

features.rationale: Complete the four right-end tapped holes on the symmetric two-by-two grid.
features.justification: Both rows and both columns are mirror images about the end-view centerlines; pitches are twice the dimensioned offsets.

notes: The build is partial pending F009 recess-corner confirmation and F011 left pilot-bore extent confirmation; unresolved features must not execute as their placeholder geometry.
